text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, have you noticed any unusual physical features, such as tall stature, a widow's peak, or a specific skin condition like café-au-lait spots? Also, when did you first notice your periods had not started?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with virilization and delayed puberty.
